mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL time above baseline fell monotonically from 19.3 to 18.0 over the four snapshot weeks, meaning households are shifting time out of the home. Each point of residential-time reduction releases discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC keeps rising over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 19.3 -> 18.0 across t-3w to t-0w while RETAIL_REC rose -44.4 -> -37.6
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is at or below its last-28-day mean (-42.55) while RESIDENTIAL continues to fall below 18.0.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS recovered 14.3 points from -39.4 to -25.1, with the largest single-week gain (+8.3) in the final week. Outdoor-activity normalization leads discretionary in-person spending by roughly two weeks, so PARKS strength propagates into RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -39.4 at t-3w to -25.1 at t-0w, a 14.3-point gain
failure_condition: PARKS holds above -30 for two more weeks but the RETAIL_REC 14-day mean does not exceed its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM climbed steadily from -3.9 to -1.0, essentially back to baseline. Near-baseline essential-errand traffic signals restored in-person shopping habit; because grocery and retail trips are frequently bundled, this habit recovery lifts RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved every week from -3.9 to -1.0
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM stays within 1 point of baseline for two weeks yet the 14-day RETAIL_REC mean is flat or lower.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has been pinned between -74.7 and -73.0 for four weeks, marking a hard containment ceiling on high-density movement. RETAIL_REC only sustains gains once TRANSIT breaks above -70, which would show the policy constraint binding transit is being lifted and unlocks retail footfall.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -70.0 percent from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved only 1.7 points (-74.7 to -73.0) across four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses above -70.0 and stays there for two consecutive weekly means while RETAIL_REC fails to exceed its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of WORKPLACES recovering off -34.9 and RESIDENTIAL falling from 19.3 to 18.0 is a commuting-restart signature. Neither series alone is decisive, but their co-movement multiplies weekday footfall near offices and drives RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -33.0 in the same week RESIDENTIAL falls below 18.0
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and RESIDENTIAL move in the joint direction for two weeks but the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean does not exceed -42.55.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-September marks the end of the outdoor season. PARKS gains (-39.4 to -25.1) are a late-summer residual that reverses as temperatures drop, and the associated fall in outdoor-adjacent browsing pulls RETAIL_REC down in the immediate week ahead.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls by 5 or more points relative to the prior weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:snapshot ends 2021-09-15, immediately after the summer outdoor peak
failure_condition: PARKS falls 5 or more points week-on-week yet the following-week RETAIL_REC value is equal to or above -37.6.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC decelerated its decline and then jumped +5.5 points in the final week (-43.1 to -37.6), an accelerating-adaptation pattern. Consumers who already re-entered retail once keep re-entering, so the momentum continues into the immediate next week rather than reversing.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC week-on-week change is +3.0 points or larger
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly changes were -0.7, +2.0, +5.5 over t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: The week following a +3.0-or-larger RETAIL_REC week-on-week gain shows a RETAIL_REC value below -37.6.

mechanism_narrative: Under a reopening-with-flat-transit regime, GROCERY_PHARM near baseline (-1.0) supplies the recovered-errand base while TRANSIT stays pinned near -73, so retail gains must come from local car-based trips rather than transit trips. That car-based substitution keeps RETAIL_REC rising over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM holds above -3.0 while TRANSIT stays below -70.0
regime_hint: reopening with transit still suppressed by containment measures
failure_condition: With GROCERY_PHARM above -3.0 and TRANSIT below -70.0 for four consecutive weeks, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or below -42.55.
